name: DVOL panic spike x oversold reversion — buy the implied-vol shock (spot)
rationale: CROSS-METRIC (dvol x rsi) on the OPPOSITE side of the only existing DVOL spec. dvol-calm-regime-momentum trades momentum when DVOL is LOW (calm weather). This spec trades the COMPLEMENT regime: a DVOL SPIKE is the crypto-native options market pricing a fear/stress shock, and when an implied-vol spike coincides with price OVERSOLD (RSI below a fitted floor), it marks a capitulation where realized panic has overshot — the VIX-equivalent fear gauge at an extreme is a classic swing-horizon mean-reversion trigger (the dvol prior literally says 'elevated DVOL marks stress or opportunity'). Mechanism before data: long spot when dvol crosses UP through a fitted spike level (fresh fear, not a stale high) AND rsi is oversold; exit when dvol normalizes back down (fear bled off) or barriers fire. Distinct from fear-greed-contrarian (crowd survey, not options-implied) and from liquidation-cascade-reversal (forced-liquidation print, not implied vol). Disconfirmer 1: drop rsi — if a bare dvol spike long matches the deflated Sharpe, the oversold confirmation adds nothing. Disconfirmer 2: a dvol spike often coincides with a crash still in motion; if requiring rsi oversold makes the edge WORSE (we are catching falling knives), the joint state is not the bottom. Disconfirmer 3 (PIT/cost): DVOL is daily next-day-available; net of ~20bps the bounce must clear. tier0 dvol + tier0 rsi, fresh DVOL prod data (Deribit), unproven combination — low-confidence until OOS.
catalyst: dvol crosses up into a fear-spike WHILE price is oversold (RSI low) — implied-vol panic overshoot, bought on spot
